BiblicalUsage: Aguwr is the swallow — the small bird that finds a nest even in God's house. The psalmist says the swallow has found a nest where she may lay her young, even at the altars of the Lord; Hezekiah chatters like a crane or a swallow in his sickness; and Jeremiah says the crane and the swallow observe the time of their coming, while God's people do not know His judgment.
TheologicalSignificance: Even the swallow finds a nest by God's altars, and this word only names the bird — the longing for His courts is the psalm's heart.
